dedupe_keys.name: portail opendata te fenua open geographic data of french polynesia bd topo cadastre hazard zoning addresses care facilities

description: Te Fenua is the geographic open data portal of the Government of French Polynesia, run by its information systems directorate with data from the land affairs, planning, marine resources and other services. The portal read on 2026-09-28 offers an open data API, and its dataset search lists 80 datasets, including the BD TOPO topographic database of French Polynesia (roads, buildings, hydrography, relief and land cover), the public cadastre and cadastral parcels, road kilometre points and road furniture, maritime signalling, natural risk prevention plan hazard and zoning layers, landslide footprints and expert reports for Tahiti, tsunami hazard, the national address base, health facilities and communal shelters, schools, general land-use plans and the exclusive economic zone. Coverage is French Polynesia. Access is free download; the portal's conditions of use were not read. Caveats: layers come from several services with their own dates, and utility networks are not among them. It supports hazard exposure and emergency response studies on the islands, such as tsunami exposure of roads, schools and shelters on Tahiti. Related record: the ISPF 2022 census fact sheets give the dwelling data that complement the layers.
